readme: The studies the demonstration loads. Nothing here is committed as pixel data: scripts/fetch-studies.mjs downloads these series from The Cancer Imaging Archive at setup time. They are real clinical acquisitions, de-identified by the archive before publication.

source.note: Each download carries the collection licence inside it; scripts/fetch-studies.mjs keeps that file next to the images it applies to.

LIDC-IDRI.title: The Lung Image Database Consortium image collection
LIDC-IDRI.citation: Armato III, S. G., McLennan, G., Bidaut, L., McNitt-Gray, M. F., Meyer, C. R., Reeves, A. P., Zhao, B., Aberle, D. R., Henschke, C. I., Hoffman, E. A., et al. (2015). Data From LIDC-IDRI. The Cancer Imaging Archive.

CPTAC-CCRCC.title: The Clinical Proteomic Tumor Analysis Consortium Clear Cell Renal Cell Carcinoma collection
CPTAC-CCRCC.citation: National Cancer Institute Clinical Proteomic Tumor Analysis Consortium (CPTAC). (2018). Radiology Data from the Clinical Proteomic Tumor Analysis Consortium Clear Cell Renal Cell Carcinoma [CPTAC-CCRCC] collection. The Cancer Imaging Archive.

CMMD.title: The Chinese Mammography Database
CMMD.citation: Cui, C., Li, L., Cai, H., Fan, Z., Zhang, L., Dan, T., Li, J., & Wang, J. (2021). The Chinese Mammography Database (CMMD): An online mammography database with biopsy confirmed types for machine diagnosis of breast. The Cancer Imaging Archive.

CMB-BRCA.title: Cancer Moonshot Biobank — Breast Cancer
CMB-BRCA.citation: National Cancer Institute Clinical Proteomic Tumor Analysis Consortium. (2022). Cancer Moonshot Biobank - Breast Cancer Collection (CMB-BRCA). The Cancer Imaging Archive.

studies.label: Chest CT, lung nodule screening
studies.note: A single thick-slice chest CT. The long series is what the montage was built for: 134 frames are tedious to scroll and quick to read as a sheet.

studies.label: Abdominal CT, multiphase
studies.note: Pre-contrast, bone kernel and a seven minute delayed phase of one acquisition. Three series of the same anatomy is the case a hanging protocol exists to serve.

studies.label: Renal MR
studies.note: Five sequences in two planes. Different sequences need different window settings, which is what makes this the study to test the viewport tools against.

studies.label: Screening mammogram, four views
studies.note: Two projections of each breast, which is what a screening study is. It is here because it is nothing like the others: eight bits rather than sixteen, no rescale to Hounsfield units, no slice geometry, and an image large enough that the viewport has to fit it rather than fill with it.

studies.label: Bilateral mammogram, three named series
studies.note: A screening study whose views are separate series rather than frames of one, which is how most archives store them and the layout a viewer has to be right about. Sixteen bits, with pixel spacing, so it also measures properly - unlike the CMMD study beside it.
